title: Complete audit events for verifier rejection
goal: Ensure verifier rejection records failed observations, evaluation, reflection, and the authoritative aborted state in the same event trail as normal M6 cycles.
context: M6 currently applies an aborted StateUpdate and returns immediately when verification rejects a plan, but omits observationProduced, evaluationCompleted, and reflectionCompleted events.
forbidden_changes: Do not execute proposals rejected by verification.
Do not change verification acceptance or policy behavior.
Do not change the terminal abort reason.
acceptance_criteria: Every rejected proposal produces a failed observation with matching actionID and toolID/skillID where present.
evaluationCompleted and reflectionCompleted are emitted before the authoritative state update.
The goal is aborted and no actionExecuted event is emitted.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: Keep verifier rejection fail-closed and add only the missing audit events plus regression assertions.
